build_layer_stack_no_per_layer: build a Haiku layer stack that applies a function N times with independent parameters per layer
build_layer_stack_with_per_layer: build a Haiku layer stack that passes per-layer input arrays to each stacked function call
create_transparency_mapping: create a LayerStackTransparencyMapping protocol to map stacked module names to flat names for transparent parameter trees
review_split_params: review the _split_params function that splits stacked parameters into per-layer parameter trees using a transparency map
review_stack_params: review the _stack_params function that stacks split parameters back into a single scanned parameter tree
